verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim support for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD and Kubernetes, x86 and arm64, and SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB and MS SQL. They also say a Raspberry Pi 3 can handle small workloads. Hands-on community reports back up the low-resource claim: a $5 VPS, an Atom x7 fitlet2, 4GB RAM where GitLab lagged, running from a USB stick, and a single-binary deploy. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the multi-OS, multi-architecture and multi-database breadth (community reports cover only low-resource use and simple deployment), and a detailed architecture/database support matrix beyond marketing-page lists.
